subject: Security event brief and forensic package delivery - TrellisBank
thread_summary: Customer reported anomalous API activity. Redwood confirmed containment, compiled a redacted forensic package, and delivered a post-incident summary and SOC2/SIG-relevant artifacts. Internal tasking for evidence redaction and retention was coordinated.
messages:
From: Alex Dunne <alex.dunne@trellisbank.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: security-team@trellisbank.com
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Unusual token use detected against TrellisBank account - urgent

Hi Sofia,

We detected a burst of unusual API traffic originating from a set of keys linked to our account (account id: TR-77631) between 2026-10-19 22:10 UTC and 2026-10-20 00:06 UTC. Calls included high-volume embedding requests and a small number of generation requests that returned unexpected outputs.

Before we escalate publicly with our security team and regulator contacts, we need the following from Redwood:
- Confirmation of whether this was customer-key abuse vs platform issue
- A copy of your IR timeline (containment actions, timestamps)
- Redacted telemetry/logs showing request IDs and agent IPs seen by your edge
- Any SOC 2 / SIG / CAIQ artifacts that reference retention and logging for the last 90 days

Can you confirm receipt and an ETA for the initial packet? TrellisBank security is standing by; our legal team may request a formal notification.

Thanks,
Alex Dunne
Head of Security Operations
TrellisBank

Attachments: none
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Dunne <alex.dunne@trellisbank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 17:18:40 -0700
Subject: Re: Unusual token use detected against TrellisBank account - urgent

Alex —

Thanks for the alert and the clear asks. Confirmed receipt. We're treating this as a higher-priority security event and have started triage. Quick notes / next steps: 

1) Containment: We identified the affected API keys and disabled them at 2026-10-20T00:23:12Z. Any live requests were terminated and new tokens were issued per the standard rotation flow.

2) Forensics: We're compiling a redacted forensic package containing edge and application logs, request IDs, and network egress metadata. We'll encrypt the bundle and share via a secure Drive folder.

3) Compliance artifacts: I'm including a short IRP summary and references to our SOC 2 logging controls. Karthik will surface the specific SIG/CAIQ controls that map to logging and retention.

ETA: Initial encrypted package and IR summary by EOD 2026-10-22 (PST). If you need priority faster than that, flag here and we will expedite.

I've CC'd Marissa (Security Ops) and Karthik (Compliance) who will be action owners.

-Sofia
Sofia Ivanova | Security Liaison, Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0187

Attachments referenced: irp-summary.md (will be included in final package)
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: TrellisBank event - evidence collection & redaction checklist

Marissa / Karthik —

Following up with internal tasking so we have an audit trail for SOC 2 / SIG reviewers: 

- Marissa: Lead for log export and timeline. Pull the API gateway traces for TR-77631 between 2026-10-19T22:00:00Z and 2026-10-20T01:00:00Z. Include request IDs, user-agent, and upstream IPs. Deliver to encrypted archive: forensics_encrypted.zip.
- Karthik: Lead for compliance mapping and redaction. Identify PII-sensitive fields in payload samples and produce a redaction map. Confirm which CAIQ/SIG controls cover our retention and logging disposition.
- Me: Coordinate packaging and customer delivery; produce the redacted postmortem summary.

Retention notes: TrellisBank asked for 90-day evidence. Confirm we provide telemetry for last 90 days where available, and note any gaps. Also confirm that this delivery meets our standard SOC 2 evidence disclosure policy and does not expose internal debug tokens.

Please update JIRA SEC-9342 with progress and attach the encrypted bundle when ready.

Thanks,
Sofia

> Alex —
>
> Thanks for the alert and the clear asks. Confirmed receipt. We're treating this as a higher-priority security event and have started triage. Quick notes / next steps: ...
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Dunne <alex.dunne@trellisbank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, security-team@trellisbank.com
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: TrellisBank — redacted forensic package & post-incident summary

Alex / TrellisBank security team —

Attached and linked below is the redacted forensic package and a short post-incident summary. Summary highlights: 

- Timeline: anomalous requests observed 2026-10-19T22:10:34Z — 2026-10-20T00:06:12Z; affected keys disabled at 2026-10-20T00:23:12Z.
- Root cause: unauthorized use of an API key belonging to a rotated but unrevoked integration credential; activity appears to be credential misuse rather than a platform-wide exploitation.
- Containment: keys disabled, token rotation recommended for associated integrations, rate limits applied to the affected account for 24 hours.
- Impact: estimated token-level exposure limited to the single integration; no customer data exfiltration detected in application payloads.
- Next steps: Redwood will retain full telemetry for 90 days and provide continued access to an encrypted forensic archive. We recommend TrellisBank rotate any downstream secrets that referenced these tokens.

Delivery details: 
- Encrypted forensics bundle (forensics_encrypted.zip) — contains edge logs, request ID index, and network metadata. MD5 checksum and password exchange via previously provisioned SSO key.
- Post-incident summary (postmortem_redacted.pdf) — redacted timeline and control actions.
- IR summary (irp-summary.md) — description of Redwood containment and our SOC 2 logging controls mapping.

Secure links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B_example_forensics
JIRA ticket: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/SEC-9342

If TrellisBank wants an on-call walkthrough, we can schedule a 30–45 minute technical debrief (we can include engineering and SRE) — propose windows: Fri 2026-10-23 09:00–11:00 PST or Mon 2026-10-26 08:00–12:00 PST.

Please confirm receipt and say if you need additional log retention or a SOC 2 attestation letter for your audit package.

Regards,
Sofia Ivanova
Security Liaison | Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0187

Attachments: forensics_encrypted.zip (encrypted, contains logs and index), postmortem_redacted.pdf, irp-summary.md
